title: Myro.bot
challenge: The existing website for the wall-painting robotics company suffered from slow load times, heavy media handling issues, and lacked a modern technical presentation aligned with an advanced robotics brand. Performance bottlenecks and inefficient asset delivery were impacting user experience.
solution: Conducted a full design and performance audit before rebuilding the platform from scratch using React.js. Implemented optimized media delivery using Cloudinary CDN, reduced render-blocking assets, integrated Firebase for blog and backend services, and added subtle Framer Motion animations for premium interaction while maintaining performance integrity.
fullDescription: Redeveloped the official website for Myro, a wall-painting robotics company, as a client project executed under Indiefluence.in. Worked alongside a UI/UX designer and handled complete frontend and backend integration as a Full Stack Developer. Over multiple years, managed redesign iterations to modernize the brand and improve performance standards.
outcomes: Improved overall website performance by 70% and significantly reduced infrastructure costs through CDN optimization.

title: House of Aerawat
challenge: High-end jewelry brands require a refined digital presence that reflects exclusivity and trust. Standard e-commerce structures felt too transactional and failed to represent luxury positioning. Additionally, the platform required secure payments, role-based authentication, and a scalable admin system for managing inventory and orders.
solution: Led the architecture and full-stack development of a custom luxury e-commerce platform built with Next.js. Designed the database schema using Supabase, integrated secure payment gateway, implemented role-based authentication, and developed a full admin panel for managing products, stock, orders, sales metrics, and automated email notifications. Optimized media delivery using Cloudinary CDN while maintaining clean, premium UI aesthetics.
fullDescription: Developed House of Aerawat as a client project executed under Indiefluence.in. Worked as Full Stack Developer while leading a small team of one additional developer and a UI/UX designer. Took ownership of system architecture decisions, database modeling, and technology stack selection. Built a high-performance, luxury-focused e-commerce platform with admin management tools and secure checkout infrastructure.
outcomes: Successfully launched a scalable luxury e-commerce platform with secure payments, admin analytics, and automated order communication system.

title: Rabbit Auto Care
challenge: As a newly launched automotive service brand, Rabbit Auto Care required a complete digital infrastructure to establish strong online presence while handling complex service logistics, real-time order tracking, discount logic, and inventory control. Manual coordination between customers, service teams, and logistics partners was inefficient and error-prone.
solution: Led the system architecture and full-stack development of a scalable automotive service platform. Designed and implemented a logistics engine integrated with Shiprocket API, secure payment gateway integration, and a comprehensive admin control panel managing banners, featured products, discount coupons, combo kits, pricing calculations, and order states. Built a structured service workflow system to track each vehicle from booking to completion.
fullDescription: Developed Rabbit Auto Care as a client project executed under Indiefluence.in. Acted as Technical Lead while actively coding core modules of the platform. Made architectural decisions, selected technology stack, and designed database schema. Built a heavy administrative backend controlling all operational aspects of the website, enabling the company to scale operations efficiently and establish a strong digital presence.
outcomes: Established a scalable automotive marketplace platform now handling 200+ daily users with automated logistics and centralized admin control.

title: Genesis Classes
challenge: The coaching institute required a robust digital platform capable of handling massive traffic during JEE/NEET mock test seasons. Peak-time submission spikes caused performance bottlenecks and required a highly scalable architecture to prevent downtime during live examinations.
solution: Led the system architecture design using a microservices-based approach to isolate test engines, user management, and analytics modules. Implemented scalable infrastructure capable of handling 20,000–30,000 concurrent users during peak periods. Improved UI/UX structure and optimized performance to ensure sub-second response during exam submissions.
fullDescription: Developed Genesis Classes as a client project executed under Indiefluence.in. Acted as Technical Lead, architecting a high-scale learning management system for competitive exam preparation (JEE & NEET). Designed microservices for running test series, managing student submissions, and handling analytics. Built an administrative panel for managing courses, announcements, and test updates while ensuring system stability during high-traffic exam seasons.
outcomes: Successfully scaled platform to handle 20k–30k concurrent users during peak examination periods with stable performance.
